cues.en: In this video, I will introduce you to a website and set of resources that are provided through an organization called Hugging Face.
cues.zh: 這支影片會介紹 Hugging Face 這個組織提供的網站與一組資源。

cues.en: You can't go wrong with a name like Hugging Face.
cues.zh: 有這麼可愛的名字，應該不會錯。

cues.en: Hugging face is a fairly new company focused on AI and natural language processing.
cues.zh: Hugging Face 是相對新的公司，專注 AI 與自然語言處理。

cues.en: They started with the goal of making as much of NLP, natural language Processing open source and as available as possible.
cues.zh: 起初的目標，是讓 NLP，也就是自然語言處理，盡可能開源、容易取得。

cues.en: It started off as a fairly small startup, and now it's one of the biggest orgs in AI platform and development
cues.zh: 一開始是小型新創，現在則是 AI 平台、開發

cues.en: tools and resources.
cues.zh: 工具與資源領域最大的組織之一。

cues.en: We are going to use several resources that are available from Hugging Face in this course, including their library of pre-trained LM and data sets.
cues.zh: 這門課會用幾項 Hugging Face 資源，包括預訓練語言模型庫，以及資料集。

cues.en: Now there's a lot more going on in the hugging face org than just what we will be using in this course.
cues.zh: Hugging Face 還有很多內容，遠超過這門課會用到的範圍。

cues.en: So if you're curious, you can explore their website more on your own time if you like.
cues.zh: 有興趣可以利用自己的時間，多探索網站。

cues.en: There are three aspects of hugging Face that I will show you in this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片會展示三個面向。

cues.en: The models and the data sets.
